semiconductor_relevance: High — Dongwoo Fine-Chem specializes in high-purity semiconductor chemicals and materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Dongwoo Fine-Chem Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of high-purity chemicals, etchants, and photo resists used in semiconductor manufacturing. The company also produces color filters and polarizing filters critical for TFT-LCD production, contributing significantly to the IT industry.
capabilities: Color filters and polarizing filters for TFT-LCD

regional_presence.Korea: Dongwoo Fine-Chem has established itself as a key player in the Korean IT industry, leveraging its position within the global network of Sumitomo Chemicals.
